definition: פּוּר noun masculine lot (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; perhaps Assyrian loanword from puru, buru, stone Jen ZA x. 339 f. and in Wild Est p. 173 f. ); ** Scheft 49 f. compare Old Iranian fravi , etc., progress, fortune, fate, lot. — explained by הַגּוֺרָל Esth 3:7 ; Esth 9:24 שֵׁם הַפּוּר v Esth 9:26 explains name of feast פּוּרִים v Esth 9:26 יְמֵי הַפֻּרִים days of Purim v Esth 9:28 v Esth 9:31 ׳ אִגֶּרֶת הַפּ v Esth 9:29 , ׳ דִּבְרֵי הַפּ v Esth 9:32 . — See on Purim especially Now Archaeology ii. 194 ff and references .
